title: Keep slim core release clippy green
goal: Make the default slim core build pass the production workflow clippy gate after restoring local-engine-only provisioning.

reuse.searched: Inspected the existing local-engine feature gate, tokenizer validator, lifecycle tests, and the workflow clippy command that selected the affected core packages.
reuse.reason: The provisioning helpers already implement the required behavior; the slim build only needed feature/test cfg boundaries and the existing tokenizer validator wired into the already-owned cache path.
